ABOUT THE APPROACH

Essence Therapy,
beginning with embodied experience.

As emotions and reactions recur, body sensations provide a gateway to further understanding of inner experience.

Essence TherapyFounded by Michel Claeys, it is a body-centered psychological counseling method. It helps the client identify the injured inner space and the resourceful inner space, and work on the current experience under the guidance of the counselor.

The fruits of inner work also need to continue to be integrated in daily life and relationships through specific choices.

◌ 01 / Presence

See the feeling at this moment

Identify the specific feelings of emotions based on the experience that is happening in the body.

↗ ◎ 02 / Inner resources

Connect with inner resources

Learn to recognize different inner spaces and practice returning to a position that supports you.

↗ ✺ 03 / Integration

Bring change back to daily life

Continue practicing in real lives and relationships to translate new insights into daily choices.

THE LEARNING JOURNEY

Learning path:
Theory, demonstrations and exercises

Establish theoretical understanding from works and published articles; develop practical abilities through method demonstrations, group exercises and supervision feedback during the course, and continue to integrate them after class.

  1. 01

    Learn how

    Read Michel Claeys’s Chinese works and public articles to understand the core concepts.

  2. 02

    Essence Therapy Level I

    Understand the inner space and core processes through on-site demonstrations and exercises.

    See the first level course ↗
  3. 03

    Special topics and second level

    Deepen your understanding of methods and practices through the second-level course or dreamwork workshop.

    View Spring Courses ↗
  4. 04

    Practice and Integrate

    Continue to practice in daily relationships and practical work to consolidate what you have learned.

MEET MICHEL CLAEYS

Michel Claeys

Michel Claeys Bouuaert

  • Belgian psychotherapist
  • Essence TherapyFounder
  • Organizer of the World Congress of Humanistic Psychology
  • Founder of the French emotional intelligence association

Michel Claeys has more than 40 years of practical experience in professional consulting. From 2000 to 2015, he focused on Beijing and conducted lectures and training. His Chinese works cover Essence Therapy, dreamwork, emotional intelligence education and parenting.
